company.name: Lean Technologies
company.shortDescription: Lean Technologies is a fintech platform offering an API that powers financial products with essential data and payments tools.
company.description: Lean Technologies is a FinTech startup that develops a platform to provide access to consumer financial data. The company's API suite, designed to abstract developers from the fragmentation of the financial infrastructure, enables businesses to seamlessly access their customers' financial data and initiate instant bank transfers. The company aims to enhance the accessibility, transparency, and utility of financial data and payments for consumers and businesses, promoting a more inclusive and interconnected financial landscape.
